title: Recurring HVAC Temperature Alarm Response
summary: For recurring supply air temperature alarms (>3 times in 30 days), inspect filter and damper before escalating.
rules: Create work order if alarm recurs more than 3 times in 30 days
Priority: medium for warning severity with confirmed recurring pattern
Priority: high if severity is critical or occupancy zone affected
Do not defer filter replacement beyond 5 business days for recurring alarms

title: Standard Filter Replacement Schedule
summary: Replace AHU filters every 90 days or when filter pressure alarm occurs.
rules: Emergency replacement allowed for recurring temperature alarms
